name: Webform Publish
description: Adds a permission to publish/unpublish webforms (control webform availability by role).
project_description:
Back to top 

 INTRODUCTION 
 This adds a permission 'Publish Webform', and a "Published" checkbox on the webform settings pages.

 
 By default, existing Webforms are "Published". 
 New webforms are all unpublished. 
 The submit form for unpublished webforms cannot be accessed. 
 
 Back to top 

 REQUIREMENTS 
 Webforms

 Back to top 

 INSTALLATION 
 Enable the module in the normal way.
